messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED: autoscaler shortfall - GPU pool saturation (us-west-2). Impact: higher latency and 502s for realtime-generation routes. Paging oncall.
alex: Oncall here, pinged. Looking now. Can someone post initial customer impact / routes affected?
jamie: Seeing spike in support tickets re: timeouts for /v1/generate and /v1/chat. A handful of enterprise customers reported degraded p99 latency ~> 18s. No data exfil.
priya: I'm pulling metrics. Queue depth for realtime-queue spiked ~00:03 UTC from 12 -> 240. Token generation stalled. HPA external metric (pending_routing) didn't scale beyond 10 -> target 30 due to adapter errors.
alex: Can you paste the HPA and adapter logs?
priya: Sure. here's the HPA status.
priya: ```
kubectl get hpa -n inference realtime-hpa -o yaml
# status:
#  currentReplicas: 10
#  desiredReplicas: 30
#  conditions:
#    - type: ScalingActive
#      status: False
#      reason: FailedGetMetrics
#      message: failed to get external metric pending_routing from external metrics API: context deadline exceeded
```
marta: GPU pool reports full allocation. pool-usw2-gpu-1: capacity 32 GPUs, allocated 32, pending pods 18.
seb: Warmup logs show a lot of cold-start timeouts. Many newly scheduled pods failed readiness probes for kv-cache warmup.
seb: ```
[2026-03-15T00:02:12Z] pod inference-xyz init: fetching model weights...
[2026-03-15T00:02:35Z] pod inference-xyz readiness probe: timeout
[2026-03-15T00:02:40Z] pod inference-xyz crashloop: OOM while preallocating cache
```
jamie: Customer impact summary: 8 customers with >5% request errors, a few high-traffic customers saw retry storms causing further pressure.
alex: Immediate mitigation - steps?
priya: 1) Disable autoscaler target check that relies on external adapter to allow HPA to scale on CPU for short term. 2) Manually increase GPU pool by adding warm spare nodes. 3) Enable fallback routing to smaller model variant for realtime routes.
alex: I'll start fallback route to rtm-lite for non-enterprise customers. @marta can you spin additional nodes? Prioritize customers with no dedicated capacity.
marta: Spinning +6 GPU nodes in pool-usw2-gpu-1 now. ETA ~4m. Also increasing pod eviction priority to free up resources from batch jobs.
seb: While nodes come up, I recommend lowering readiness probe timeout to avoid long warmup stalls so readiness doesn't block scheduling. Changing to 45s -> 20s for warmup probe on canary.
priya: Applying HPA temp patch to allow scale by CPU metric.
priya: ```
kubectl patch hpa realtime-hpa -n inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/metrics","value":[{"type":"Resource","resource":{"name":"cpu","target":{"type":"Utilization","averageUtilization":60}}}]}]'
```
alex: Good. Also enabling prefix cache bypass for currently running pods to reduce KV warmup pressure.
jamie: Noted. Support updated customers: "We're routing to a lower-latency fallback for some routes, engineers are mitigating; ETA 10-15m".
incident-bot: oncall-rotation-bot assigned alex as primary oncall (rotation rule)
oncall-rotation-bot: alex is oncall until 2026-03-15T08:00:00Z
priya: Metrics update: queue depth decreasing from 240 -> 80 after fallback and node spin-up. p99 latency dropping from 18s -> 6s.
seb: After lowering readiness probe timeouts, pod readiness success rate improved. But we saw OOMs on some older images - bumping pod memory limit for warmup phase.
marta: New nodes are up and kube-scheduler placed 12 pods. GPU utilization on pool now 88% -> still high but under 95% saturation.
alex: Good. Next: timeline and hypotheses for RCA notes (in-thread):
alex: Timeline:
- 00:00: External traffic surge to realtime routes
- 00:01: Queue depth rising + HPA external adapter failed to fetch metric
- 00:02: Scheduled pods attempted warmup -> readiness timeouts + OOMs
- 00:03: GPU pool saturated, pending pods backlog
- 00:04: Incident auto-detected and paged oncall
- 00:06: Mitigations: fallback routing, HPA patch, +6 nodes spun
- 00:10: Queue depth down, p99 improving

alex: Hypotheses (track):
- H1: External metrics adapter throttled/timeouted -> HPA couldn't scale (evidence: HPA condition FailedGetMetrics). Severity: high. Action: check adapter logs + move to controller fallback.
- H2: Warmup sequence causes long readiness -> pods take too long and fail, increasing pending backlog (evidence: warmup timeouts/OOMs). Severity: medium. Action: review readiness probe and memory/cold-start path.
- H3: Burst capacity insufficient for sudden spike; our warm spare policy wasn't aggressive enough (evidence: pool at 100% capacity). Severity: medium. Action: revisit warm spare sizing and pre-warm heuristics.

priya: Adding data sources for RCA: HPA events, external-metrics-adapter logs, kube-scheduler events, GPU-pool autoscaler logs, warmup container logs.
priya: Pasting adapter error snippet:
priya: ```
2026-03-15T00:01:57Z external-metrics-adapter error: GET /metrics pending_routing context deadline exceeded (500ms)
2026-03-15T00:02:01Z external-metrics-adapter error: rate limit exceeded to monitoring API
```
seb: Also saw a spike in monitoring API latency at 00:01:50Z.
jamie: Support action items: keep customers updated, flag enterprise customers with dedicated capacity to verify if they saw impact (likely small for dedicated).
alex: Handing off to priya for post-incident RCA coordination. I'll mark as acknowledged and move to investigation channel after initial timeline is added. Thanks all.
priya: I'll compile timeline, attach dashboards and logs, and start RCA doc. Adding owners for each hypothesis: H1 -> priya, H2 -> seb, H3 -> marta.
alex: If anything regresses ping me with "regress:autoscale" tag. I'll stay available.
marta: Quick note for RCA: include kube-scheduler predicates + taint changes (we evicted batch jobs). That likely contributed to pressure redistribution.
seb: Will dig into image memory usage during warmup and link heap profiles.
jamie: I'll follow up with customer success on the postmortem comms draft once RCA is ready.
incident-bot: Incident transitioned to 'mitigated' at 1782003675. Owners assigned. Reminder: file post-incident report within 72h.
alex: Closing incident thread here; moving RCA work to doc and #eng-postmortems. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
